Fixed vimanam CI failure on PRs #91 and #92: CI stable had moved to Rust 1.98 whose clippy question_mark lint flagged the pre-existing resolve_ref loop in src/utils.rs (local default toolchain 1.96 passed). Rewrote the loop with ? via match on Value::Object/Array, committed 1b06b71 on feat/completions-hygiene-stats, rebased feat/diff on it and force-pushed. All CI checks now green on both PRs. [Resource] (score 5.15)
